<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Hero image -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="520" fill="#C4C4C4"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="520" fill="#E9EEF5"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="105" r="34" fill="#FFD789" opacity="0.95"/>
    <polygon points="0,420 70,350 130,390 190,320 250,370 315,300 390,345 390,520 0,520" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.95"/>
    <polygon points="0,445 62,390 115,420 175,350 238,400 305,332 390,390 390,520 0,520" fill="#0F5FCC" opacity="0.82"/>
    <polygon points="58,420 105,338 170,395 222,300 292,350 340,260 390,330 390,520 0,520 0,475" fill="#1877F2" opacity="0.20"/>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="520" fill="#000000" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="28" y="80" width="130" height="74" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="28" y="80" width="130" height="74" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>
    <circle cx="66" cy="116" r="15" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.35"/>
    <circle cx="112" cy="108" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.20"/>
    <rect x="56" y="110" width="20" height="24" rx="9" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.22"/>
    <polygon points="118,132 135,104 151,120 160,110 166,132" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.30"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="none"/>
    <text x="22" y="28" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
    <g transform="translate(308,14)">
      <circle cx="4" cy="12" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="8" cy="9" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="12" cy="6" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <circle cx="16" cy="3" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(329,12)">
      <rect x="0" y="5" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.9"/>
      <rect x="2" y="7" width="13" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="20" y="8.5" width="2.5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(361,12)">
      <circle cx="6" cy="9" r="4.2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="9.2" y1="12.2" x2="13" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Foreground card -->
  <rect x="22" y="474" width="346" height="276" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
  <rect x="22" y="472" width="346" height="276" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="22" y="472" width="346" height="276" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.96"/>

  <!-- Copy -->
  <text x="42" y="532" fill="#050505" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12">Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy</text>
  <text x="42" y="566" fill="#4E4B66" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12">Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text of the printing and typesetting</text>
  <text x="42" y="590" fill="#4E4B66" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12">industry. Stay informed with concise headlines, curated stories,</text>
  <text x="42" y="614" fill="#4E4B66" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12">and trusted reporting tailored to your interests.</text>

  <!-- Dots -->
  <g transform="translate(150,646)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6.5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <circle cx="18" cy="0" r="6.5" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <circle cx="36" cy="0" r="6.5" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Button -->
  <g transform="translate(42,676)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="306" height="52" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="153" y="33" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.12">Next</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g transform="translate(31,781)">
      <polygon points="18,4 6,14 30,14" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="9" y="14" width="18" height="14" rx="2" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="18" y="42" fill="#1877F2" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <g transform="translate(111,780)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="14" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="8" x2="21.5" y2="18.5" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="18" y1="8" x2="13" y2="16" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="18" y="42" fill="#667080" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <g transform="translate(197,780)">
      <rect x="10" y="4" width="16" height="24" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="10,28 18,22 26,28" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="18" y="42" fill="#667080" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g transform="translate(282,780)">
      <circle cx="18" cy="12" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="8" y="21" width="20" height="10" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="18" y="42" fill="#667080" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
